title: LibreCAD JWW default DIMSTYLE overload regression

source.method: Disposable clean source clone in /private/tmp. The user's LibreCAD checkout was not modified.

finding: After a successful JWW import, when no DIMSTYLE string exists, the literal Standard is passed to overloaded RS_Graphic::addVariable. The const-char-pointer-to-bool standard conversion wins over constructing QString, so the fallback is stored as integer 1 rather than a group-2 string. This is independently demonstrated on the registered JWW path; it is distinct from the DXFRW fix.

control.fixture: Existing test helper writes a one-line version-600 JWW from scratch with JWWDocument::Save; the test imports it through RS_FilterJWW, deletes the temporary input, and asserts actual variable type, group and value. No JWW fixture is added to the repository.
control.red: With original JWW literal: import succeeds but the VariableString and Standard value assertions fail; 6 assertions pass and 2 fail, exit 42. Log SHA-256 473d0340a0117585a88ed296a774c7741359ddc0bf594b6abe9236a69af7e9bd.
control.green: Changing only the fallback to QStringLiteral("Standard") passes 8/8 assertions, exit 0. Log SHA-256 9d66ee552a2acf816ed7f0996459e7c7b17ae605a9122c932deef49d00d755a5; green test executable SHA-256 4d667203ccdff09d1a978cbabf14b5876c906700e93d99cb84af6af5ebdbe3f0.

integration.host: macOS 27.2.1 build 26B131 ARM64, Apple clang 21.0.0, Qt 6.12.0
integration.method: Reuse the scratch system-package CMake override and the separate SHP/JWW public-codepage compatibility patch documented in p8-librecad-master-dimstyle-literal-dwg-export-2026-11-18.json; the candidate also contains the separate DXFRW correction and scratch diagnostics. A scratch-only micro test target reuses the application library; it is not part of the proposed patch.

patch.scope: One JWW QStringLiteral correction plus a focused generated regression in existing jww_import_tests.cpp; no DXFRW patch or legacy DXF source change.
patch.applyCheck: git apply --cached --check against the pristine LibreCAD 7396 index: PASS. Not submitted upstream.

legacyDxf: The other matching literal is in RS_FilterDXF, whose source is absent from the current CMake application build and registered filter list; its old dl_dxf.h dependency was unavailable when a scratch test was attempted. Its static pattern alone is not evidence of an observable current application failure, so it is not changed here.
limits: One generated JWW import and exact variable assertions; no downstream DWG export or independent application readback is claimed.
No Windows, non-ASCII path, native GUI, broad suite, producer-authored JWW, or general JWW support claim is established.
